dev_walker.text: The staircase is the highest point, and it is not even the hardest bit. The hardest bit is the sign that says how far to go.
I am going to Fort William. I have said that for three days. It still sounds like a joke.

dev_climber.text: There is an indoor ice wall in the old works. It is the one place in Scotland where you can be cold on purpose and pay for it.
Slàinte mhath, that is 'good health'. We say it with a mug of tea here.

dev_hydro.text: The smelter needed a lot of power, so they built a dam up here and sent the water down in pipes. You can still see where it ran.
The works are gone, but the loch is still full. The hills have a long memory for water.

dev_cafe.text: Everyone comes in off the Way looking like they have been through a hedge. A bacon roll fixes about half of them.
The Staircase is not as bad as it sounds. It is worse. But it is over quickly, and the cake is good.
